fields.Name: IT78 - Materialized Entity Base-View Read Redirect
fields.Description: Live-DB proof that RunView(DataSource:'Materialized') on an entity is served from the entity's physical snapshot via resolveEffectiveBaseView, not the live base view (the higher-blast-radius redirect that can affect RunView for any entity). Fabricates an EntityBaseView MaterializedResult (SourceEntityID) + a snapshot carrying a sentinel row absent from the live view; EMR1 asserts a Materialized RunView returns the sentinel, EMR2 (negative control) asserts the same read Live returns it nowhere. Server transport. Self-cleaning fixtures; SQL-Server only (skips when no mssql pool).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A Materialized RunView on the entity is served from the snapshot (returns the sentinel) while the same read Live returns the sentinel nowhere. 2 checks (EMR1-EMR2).
